temp="hello=good="
please write code to use .split() to split it into ["hello", "good="]

message.content:
You can tell `split()` to stop after the first separator by passing a *maxsplit* argument.  
In this case you want to split on the first “=” only:

```python
temp = "hello=good="
parts = temp.split('=', 1)   # split on '=' but only once
print(parts)                 # ['hello', 'good=']
```

`split('=', 1)` splits the string at the first “=” and leaves the rest of the string (including any additional “=”) untouched, giving you exactly `["hello", "good="]`.
